releases.name: magpie-ducoro 0.4.11
releases.body:
Trace resource assignments, compare two Bots, and try a shared plan on one Bot before rolling it out. Sync previews now show why resources will be removed and when the first gateway connection will be created.

## Added

- Find which Bots receive a skill or library connector, where the assignment comes from, and its latest read-back result.
- Compare two Bots across model routes, resource assignments, account tool permissions, and verification, with links to the corresponding settings.
- Try a shared plan with one Bot. The trial persists across automated syncs and host restarts. Verify it before rolling it out or restoring the previous plan.

## Changed

- Show why a resource will be removed when assignments, switches, library entries, or export files change. Flag first-time gateway connection creation in the preview.
- Poll the task center less frequently while idle and refresh immediately when returning to the page or retrying sync.

## Fixed

- Accept null resource lists in Magpie exports and preserve managed connector records when the MCP export is unreadable.
- Keep instruction previews, writes, and read-back verification consistent when Ducoro normalizes blank lines around a managed instruction block.
- Check the configured gateway route during read-back and verify skill contents and file modes from a single scan.

## Maintenance & Dependencies

- Use the package version in the plugin page and diagnostics, and check versioned installation examples before packaging.

## Installation & Upgrade

Stop the previous plugin host before upgrading. Add the GitHub ref in Magpie or extract the source archive and register the extracted folder by absolute path. GitHub provides the ZIP and tar.gz source archives under Assets. [GitHub Release](https://github.com/YE4IM/magpie-ducoro/releases/tag/v0.4.11)

```bash
magpie plugin add github:YE4IM/magpie-ducoro#v0.4.11
```

Installation and end-to-end sync in a configured Magpie and Ducoro environment were unverified for this release.

## Full Changelog

- [Full Changelog](https://github.com/YE4IM/magpie-ducoro/compare/v0.4.10...v0.4.11)

---

可反查资源分配、对比两个 Bot，并在推广共享方案前先让一个 Bot 试用。同步预览会说明资源撤销原因，并标出首次创建网关连接的操作。

## 新增功能

- 从技能或资源库连接器反查接收它的 Bot，并查看分配来源和最近一次读回核验结果。
- 对比两个 Bot 的模型路由、资源分配、账户工具权限和核验结果，并从差异项打开对应设置。
- 让一个 Bot 试用共享方案。试用状态会跨自动同步和宿主重启保留，可核验后推广或恢复原方案。

## 优化与改进

- 分配、开关、资源库条目或导出文件变化时，预览会说明资源撤销原因，并标出首次创建网关连接的操作。
- 任务中心在空闲时逐步降低轮询频率，切回页面或重试同步时立即刷新。

## 问题修复

- 兼容 Magpie 导出中以 null 表示的空资源列表，并在 MCP 导出不可读时保留托管连接器记录。
- Ducoro 规范化托管指令区块外侧空行时，保持指令预览、写入和读回核验一致。
- 读回时核对配置的网关路由，并通过一次扫描核验技能内容和文件权限。

## 维护与依赖更新

- 插件页面和诊断统一读取包版本，打包前检查安装示例中的版本号。

## 安装与升级

升级前先停止旧版插件宿主。在 Magpie 中添加 GitHub 引用，也可下载并解压源码，再通过文件夹绝对路径注册。GitHub 在 Assets 中提供 ZIP 和 tar.gz 源码归档。[GitHub Release](https://github.com/YE4IM/magpie-ducoro/releases/tag/v0.4.11)

```bash
magpie plugin add github:YE4IM/magpie-ducoro#v0.4.11
```

本次发布未在已配置的 Magpie 和 Ducoro 环境中验证安装及端到端同步。

## 完整变更日志

- [完整变更日志](https://github.com/YE4IM/magpie-ducoro/compare/v0.4.10...v0.4.11)

releases.name: magpie-ducoro 0.4.10
releases.body:
The installation guide now starts with registering the plugin in Magpie. It also shows how to preview and save a first sync, then check the result.

## Maintenance & Documentation

- The installation guide clarifies Magpie page-service support, the `ducoro-cli` and background-service requirements, and the limits of compatibility testing.
- The first-use guide walks through previewing and saving changes, then checking sync status and running a read-only diagnostic.

## Installation & Upgrade

In Magpie, open **Plugins → Add a plugin** and enter `magpie-ducoro@0.4.10`, or run:

```bash
magpie plugin add magpie-ducoro@0.4.10
```

If you used `npm install` to download the package, complete registration through Magpie. The `plugin add` subcommand was confirmed in Magpie’s CLI help. Registration and upgrade were not run while preparing these notes.

npm carries only the latest version. If you need this release after a newer package is published, download the source archive from this GitHub Release and register the extracted folder in Magpie.

1. Stop the previous plugin host so both versions cannot write to the same management records at once.
2. Replace the previous plugin folder or update the configured package.
3. Reload the plugin to start the new version.

Existing settings and compatible v1/v2 management records carry forward.

## Full Changelog

- [Full Changelog](https://github.com/YE4IM/magpie-ducoro/compare/v0.4.9...v0.4.10)
- [Version history](https://github.com/YE4IM/magpie-ducoro/blob/v0.4.10/docs/CHANGELOG.md)

---

安装指南把 Magpie 插件注册放在开头，并补充了首次同步时如何预览、保存与核验结果。

## 维护与文档

- 安装指南明确了 Magpie 页面服务、`ducoro-cli` 和后台服务要求，以及兼容性验证的范围。
- 首次使用指南说明如何预览并保存变更、查看同步状态，以及运行只读诊断。

## 安装与升级

在 Magpie 的「插件 → 添加插件」中输入 `magpie-ducoro@0.4.10`，或运行：

```bash
magpie plugin add magpie-ducoro@0.4.10
```

通过 `npm install` 下载软件包后，请在 Magpie 中完成注册。已在 Magpie 命令行帮助中核对 `plugin add` 子命令，本次整理未实际执行注册或升级。

npm 仅保留最新版。如果更新的 npm 包已发布，需要安装这一版时，请下载本 GitHub Release 的源码压缩包，解压后在 Magpie 中注册该目录。

1. 先停止旧版插件宿主，避免两个版本同时写入管理记录。
2. 替换旧版插件目录，或更新已配置的安装包。
3. 重载插件以启动新版。

已有设置及兼容的 v1/v2 管理记录可继续使用。

## 完整变更日志

- [完整变更日志](https://github.com/YE4IM/magpie-ducoro/compare/v0.4.9...v0.4.10)
- [版本历史](https://github.com/YE4IM/magpie-ducoro/blob/v0.4.10/docs/CHANGELOG.md)

releases.name: magpie-ducoro 0.4.8
releases.body:
First-time setup can create a Ducoro connection when none exists. Preview, sync, and verification now use the same rules for selecting resources.

## Fixed

- Accept the CLI’s explicit JSON `null` for an absent connection and omit empty capability references when creating one. Updating can still explicitly clear old references, while empty or malformed CLI output blocks writes.
- Preview connector revocations when an export disables a connector. A skill scheduled for removal no longer appears as an update.

## Changed

- Bound skill scans by deadline, directory depth, count, and size, and allow cancellation.
- Read back resource state after an interruption before resuming ownership, to avoid duplicates or adopting externally modified content.
- Keep drafts, selections, focus, and open dialogs when switching languages. Source downloads contain the runtime files, UI assets, essential docs, and recovery commands.

## Validation

- The original release recorded connection lifecycle, argument, state compatibility, Node and Bun, HTTP, Magpie host loading, resource lifecycle, and bilingual UI checks on macOS arm64 with a local mock model endpoint.

## Known Limitations

- Windows and Linux compatibility, minimum supported versions, and the full native-host flow remain unverified. Some English counters can still display awkward singular or plural wording.

## Installation & Upgrade

In Magpie’s **Plugins → Add a plugin**, enter the versioned reference below. Open **Ducoro** after registration. The plugin page requires Magpie page-service support, `ducoro-cli`, and a running Ducoro background service.

```text
github:YE4IM/magpie-ducoro#v0.4.8
```

1. Stop the previous plugin host so both versions cannot write to the same management records at once.
2. Replace the previous plugin folder or update the configured package.
3. Reload the plugin to start the new version.

Existing settings and compatible management records carry forward.

Plugin registration and upgrade were not retested while updating these notes.

## Full Changelog

- [Full Changelog](https://github.com/YE4IM/magpie-ducoro/compare/v0.4.7...v0.4.8)
- [Version history](https://github.com/YE4IM/magpie-ducoro/blob/v0.4.8/docs/CHANGELOG.md)
- [Installation and usage](https://github.com/YE4IM/magpie-ducoro/blob/v0.4.8/README.md)

---

首次设置时，Ducoro 尚无连接也可以正常创建。预览、同步和核验现在使用同一套资源选择规则。

## 问题修复

- CLI 明确用 JSON `null` 返回连接不存在时可继续创建，创建时省略空能力参考。更新时仍可显式清空旧参考，空输出或损坏响应会阻止写入。
- 导出配置禁用连接器时，预览会显示撤销。待撤销的技能不再同时显示为更新。

## 优化与改进

- 限制技能扫描的总时限、目录深度、数量和规模，并支持取消。
- 中断后先读回资源状态再恢复管理归属，避免重复创建或接管已被外部修改的内容。
- 切换语言时保留草稿、选中项、焦点和打开的弹窗。源码下载保留运行文件、界面资源、必要文档和恢复命令。

## 验证范围

- 原发布记录了在 macOS arm64 上使用本地模拟模型端点进行的验证，涵盖连接生命周期、参数、状态兼容性、Node 与 Bun、HTTP、Magpie 宿主加载、资源生命周期以及双语界面。

## 已知限制

- Windows 和 Linux 兼容性、最低受支持版本及完整原生宿主流程尚未验证。少数英文计数提示仍可能出现单复数措辞问题。

## 安装与升级

在 Magpie 的「插件 → 添加插件」中输入下方的版本引用。注册后打开「Ducoro」。插件页面需要 Magpie 页面服务、`ducoro-cli` 和运行中的 Ducoro 后台服务。

```text
github:YE4IM/magpie-ducoro#v0.4.8
```

1. 先停止旧版插件宿主，避免两个版本同时写入管理记录。
2. 替换旧版插件目录，或更新已配置的安装包。
3. 重载插件以启动新版。

已有设置及兼容的管理记录可继续使用。

本次整理发布说明时未重新执行插件注册和升级。

## 完整变更日志

- [完整变更日志](https://github.com/YE4IM/magpie-ducoro/compare/v0.4.7...v0.4.8)
- [版本历史](https://github.com/YE4IM/magpie-ducoro/blob/v0.4.8/docs/CHANGELOG.md)
- [安装与使用文档](https://github.com/YE4IM/magpie-ducoro/blob/v0.4.8/README.md)

releases.name: magpie-ducoro 0.4.7
releases.body:
Grouped sync settings and expandable Bot editors make resources easier to review. The interface follows Magpie’s language and preserves drafts, selections, and focus when switching.

## Changed

- Group sync settings, expand Bot resource editors on demand, and align controls across models, connectors, and skills.
- Unify the plans, status, and backup views. **Preview and save** remains the review step before applying changes.

## Fixed

- Center the save bar’s status text next to its actions and remove the space reserved for an empty draft notice.
- Improve switch click targets while retaining keyboard operation, and fix summary loading and error feedback.

## Installation & Upgrade

Download **Source code (zip)** or **Source code (tar.gz)** from this release’s **Assets**, extract it, and add that folder’s absolute path in Magpie’s plugin settings.

Open **Ducoro** in the Magpie sidebar. The page requires Magpie page-service support, `ducoro-cli`, and a running Ducoro background service.

1. Replace the previous plugin folder or update the configured package.
2. Reload the plugin to start the new version.

Existing settings and compatible management records carry forward.

## Full Changelog

- [Full Changelog](https://github.com/YE4IM/magpie-ducoro/compare/v0.4.6...v0.4.7)
- [Version history](https://github.com/YE4IM/magpie-ducoro/blob/v0.4.7/CHANGELOG.md)
- [Detailed notes](https://github.com/YE4IM/magpie-ducoro/blob/v0.4.7/RELEASE-NOTES.md)
- [Installation and usage](https://github.com/YE4IM/magpie-ducoro/blob/v0.4.7/README.md)

---

分组后的同步设置与可展开的 Bot 编辑区更便于查看资源。界面跟随 Magpie 的语言，切换时保留草稿、选中项和焦点。

## 优化与改进

- 分组展示同步设置，按需展开 Bot 资源编辑区，并对齐模型、连接器与技能控件。
- 统一方案、状态和备份视图。应用变更前继续使用「预览并保存」审阅。

## 问题修复

- 将保存栏状态文字与操作按钮垂直居中对齐，并移除空草稿提示占位。
- 改进开关点击范围并保留键盘操作，修复摘要加载和错误提示问题。

## 安装与升级

在本页「Assets」中下载 **Source code (zip)** 或 **Source code (tar.gz)**，解压后在 Magpie 插件设置中添加该目录的绝对路径。

在 Magpie 侧栏打开「Ducoro」。页面需要 Magpie 页面服务、`ducoro-cli` 和运行中的 Ducoro 后台服务。

1. 替换旧版插件目录，或更新已配置的安装包。
2. 重载插件以启动新版。

已有设置及兼容的管理记录可继续使用。
